editorial:
Imagine landing in New York City for a dream vacation, but something feels totally off. That is exactly what happens to Alfredo and Teresa, a couple from Spain who just want to follow their guidebook and relax. At first, the weirdness is small, like a strange sign or a person acting odd. But soon, you realize they aren't in the real Big Apple at all. The movie creates a creepy feeling that makes you question everything you see on screen, leaving you wondering who is pulling the strings and why this fake city even exists.

The acting is solid and keeps you invested in the couple's panic as they try to escape. While the pace starts slow to build the mystery, it picks up speed with some great twists that will keep you guessing. The biggest pro is how it plays with your mind, though some might find the middle section a bit slow. If you love mysteries that make you think, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV or add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: You eventually find out that the couple is actually part of a twisted social experiment. The city they are in is a giant set designed to look like New York to see how people react to fake reality. The twist is that they were chosen and manipulated to be there. In the end, the movie reveals that the people running the show are watching their every move like a reality show from a control room.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological mysteries and plot twists.
